data.body: Investigation in this session (code_version=e568505fa659711a6bbcc63bdb7162bacb5a812a) confirms the underlying root cause: the main repo's .git/hooks/pre-push is a pre-commit framework hook (auto-installed by 'pre-commit install --hook-type pre-push'). When the .tickets-tracker linked worktree pushes from the orphan tickets branch (no .pre-commit-config.yaml), pre-commit exits nonzero and aborts the push unless PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG=1 is set. Reproduced: plain 'git push origin HEAD:tickets' from .tickets-tracker returns exit 1 with 'error: failed to push some refs', while 'PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG=1 git push origin HEAD:tickets' succeeds. Of the 4 ticket-push sites in plugins/dso/scripts/, three already wrap the push with the env var (ticket-lib.sh:700, merge-to-main-direct.sh:864, ticket-lifecycle.sh:210) but one does not (ticket_graph/_links.py:157). Approved fix scope (user-approved this session): (A) Add .pre-commit-config.yaml with 'repos: []' to the orphan tickets branch (one-time setup commit + seed in branch-init code path); (B) Add env={'PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG':'1', ...} to subprocess.run in _links.py to match the 3 bash callers (defense in depth).
